title: Splatoon 2's server inked in
body: Splatoon 2 runs on NEX, and so does its server. It builds, starts, serves its health endpoint, creates its schemas and registers the matchmaking surface the game uses; console contact is the step that has not happened yet. Two plain facts keep the roster straight: Splatoon 2 is NEX, Splatoon 3 is NPLN, and they are separate services in separate repositories. Ink now, consoles later.
